## Summary

I created `packages/sheets-ui/src/views/defined-name/defined-name.utils.ts` with the four required functions. The file didn't exist yet, so this was a fresh implementation (the actual repo lives under `/workspace/repo`).

**`validateDefinedName(deps)`** — Returns `'definedName.nameDuplicate'` when `definedNamesService.getValueByName` returns a non-null result (and for table-name conflicts), `'definedName.nameSheetConflict'` for sheet-name conflicts, `'definedName.nameConflict'` for function conflicts, `'definedName.nameInvalid'`/`'definedName.nameEmpty'` for bad names, and `null` when valid. This mirrors the canonical validation logic already in `@univerjs/sheets`, adapted to the simpler service signatures in the spec.

**`resolveDefinedNameBoxAction(deps)`** — Checks in order: existing defined name → `focusDefinedName`; valid cell/range reference (`isReferenceStringWithEffectiveColumn`) → `focusSelection`; passes `validateDefinedName` → `createDefinedName`; otherwise → `reset`.

**`getAbsoluteRefStringFromSelection(workbook, selections, refStringService)`** — Builds `SheetName!A1` for a single cell or `SheetName!B2:C4` for a range (using `Tools.chatAtABC` for column letters and `row + 1`), then returns `convertRefersToAbsolute(refString, AbsoluteRefType.ALL, AbsoluteRefType.ALL, sheetName)`.

**`restoreSheetNavigationAfterDefinedNameConfirm(deps)`** — Always calls `input.blur()` and returns `true`. When the editor is visible, closes it via `SetCellEditVisibleOperation` with `{ visible: false, eventType: Keyboard, keycode: ENTER, unitId }`; otherwise blurs the editor service, focuses the unit, focuses the editor, and sets the five context flags to `false`.

Key import sources verified against existing code: `DeviceInputEventType`/`hasCJKText` from `@univerjs/engine-render`, `KeyCode` from `@univerjs/ui`, `SetCellEditVisibleOperation` from the local `cell-edit.operation`, and the context keys/`Tools`/`AbsoluteRefType` from `@univerjs/core`.
